introduction.heading: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to Homework Supply. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we handle your personal data when you use our Japanese language learning platform.

informationWeCollect.heading: 2. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.intro: We collect and process the following types of information:
informationWeCollect.accountInfoText: Email address, username, and password when you create an account
informationWeCollect.learningDataText: Your assignments, grades, unit progress, and submissions
informationWeCollect.userContentText: Audio recordings, text responses, and other materials you create or upload
informationWeCollect.usageInfoText: How you interact with our platform, including pages visited and features used

howWeUseInfo.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
howWeUseInfo.item1: Provide and maintain our educational services
howWeUseInfo.item2: Track your learning progress and provide personalized feedback
howWeUseInfo.item3: Enable instructors to grade assignments and monitor student progress
howWeUseInfo.item4: Improve and optimize our platform and educational content
howWeUseInfo.item5: Communicate with you about your account and our services

dataStorage.heading: 4. Data Storage and Security
dataStorage.intro: Your data is stored securely using Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including:
dataStorage.item1: AWS Cognito for authentication and user management
dataStorage.item2: AWS DynamoDB for database storage with encryption at rest
dataStorage.item3: AWS S3 for file storage with appropriate access controls
dataStorage.outro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

dataSharing.heading: 5. Data Sharing
dataSharing.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data only in the following circumstances:
dataSharing.instructorsText: Your assignments, grades, and learning progress are visible to your instructors
dataSharing.classmatesText: Published content may be visible to other students in your section
dataSharing.aiProcessingText: We use OpenAI services to process audio transcriptions, generate feedback, and provide AI-assisted learning features
dataSharing.legalText: When required by law or to protect our rights and users

yourRights.heading: 6. Your Rights
yourRights.item5: Opt out of certain data processing activities
yourRights.outro: You can manage many of these settings through your profile page.

cookies.heading: 7. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use local storage and session storage to maintain your login state and cache data for offline functionality. We do not use third-party tracking cookies for advertising purposes.

childrensPrivacy.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.content: Our service is intended for educational use. If you are under 18, please ensure you have your parent or guardian's permission before using our platform. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children without appropriate consent.

policyChanges.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
policyChanges.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new privacy policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

contactUs.heading: 10. Contact Us
contactUs.content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our privacy practices, please contact us through your instructor or the platform administrator.
